mapper.insert: INSERT INTO feature_daily (stock_code, base_date, ma5, ma20, rsi14, macd, bollinger_upper, bollinger_lower, feature_version) VALUES (#{stockCode}, #{baseDate}, #{ma5}, #{ma20}, #{rsi14}, #{macd}, #{bollingerUpper}, #{bollingerLower}, #{featureVersion}) ON CONFLICT (stock_code, base_date, feature_version) DO UPDATE SET ma5 = EXCLUDED.ma5, ma20 = EXCLUDED.ma20, rsi14 = EXCLUDED.rsi14, macd = EXCLUDED.macd, bollinger_upper = EXCLUDED.bollinger_upper, bollinger_lower = EXCLUDED.bollinger_lower, updated_at = now()
